trailheads.name: Lambert Park
trailheads.parking_notes: Gravel lot at trailhead on E 4600 N. Limited parking on busy days.

trailheads.name: Hogs Hollow
trailheads.parking_notes: Small dirt lot at Hogs Hollow trailhead. Street parking available nearby.

trailheads.name: Three Falls (Alpine)
trailheads.parking_notes: Park along Grove Creek Dr. No formal lot — be respectful of residents.

trailheads.name: Sensei (Hidden Canyon TH)
trailheads.parking_notes: New Hidden Canyon Trailhead with paved parking. Overflow parking at upper roundabout.

trailheads.name: Andy Ballard Arena (Draper)
trailheads.parking_notes: Large paved lot at Andy Ballard Equestrian Park. Access trails from south end of parking lot.

trails.name: Bonneville Shoreline Trail - Oak Hollow Section
Bonneville Shoreline Trail - Steep Mountain Section
Bonneville Shoreline Trail - Upper Oak Hollow Section
Canyon Hollow Trail
trails.notes: Single track multi use trail. Tends to get a fair amount of mountain bike traffic. Incredibly beautiful trail. Great for trail running.

trails.name: Clarks Trail
trails.notes: Bikes uphill only. Foot and horse traffic allowed both ways

trailheads.name: Valley Vista (Pleasant Grove)
trailheads.address: Battle Creek Dr, Pleasant Grove, UT 84062
trailheads.parking_notes: Battle Creek Canyon area. Park at the trailhead lot off Battle Creek Dr.

trailheads.name: Peak View
trailheads.parking_notes: Neighborhood trailhead. Street parking on Peak View Dr.

trailheads.name: Eagle Mountain (Time Trial)
trailheads.parking_notes: Time Trial course — check current staging area with coaching staff before practice.

trailheads.name: Corner Canyon – Ghost Falls TH
trailheads.address: Corner Canyon Rd & 14600 S, Draper, UT 84020
trailheads.parking_notes: Paved lot on Corner Canyon Rd. Can fill quickly on weekends. Arrive early for weekday morning practices.

trails.name: Bonneville Shoreline Trail
trails.notes: Good warm-up trail. Runs the base of the canyon along the bench.

trails.name: Corner Canyon Trail
trails.notes: Main artery of the system. Accessible to all skill levels.

trails.name: Ghost Falls Trail
trails.notes: Namesake trail for this TH. Rocky, exposed moves near the top.

trails.name: Jacob's Ladder
trails.notes: Steep sustained climb. Primarily used as an uphill connector.

trailheads.name: Corner Canyon – Rush TH
trailheads.parking_notes: Smaller dirt lot. Overflow parking on Steep Mountain Ln. Higher elevation start than Ghost Falls TH.

trails.name: Rush Trail
trails.notes: Technical black. Exposed rocky sections, loose over hardpack in places.

trails.name: Frank
trails.notes: Sustained technical climbing. Connects Rush and Upper Rush at the top of the system.
